messages.name: exportattrs
messages.digest: Export an object's current attribute state
messages.description: Send themessage to any Jitter object to export an xml file containing that object's current attribute state.

messages.name: html_ref
messages.digest: The word, followed by a URL as a symbol, Finds the html reference page for the object specified and launches it in a web browser. This message is obsolete in the object documentation system for versions 5.0 and beyond of Max, but remains for object developers who have older style html reference documentation.
messages.description: The word, followed by a URL as a symbol, Finds the html reference page for the object specified and launches it in a web browser. This message is obsolete in the object documentation system for versions 5.0 and beyond of Max, but remains for object developers who have older style html reference documentation.

messages.name: importattrs
messages.digest: Import attribute states for an object
messages.description: Send themessage to any Jitter object to import attribute states from a previously exported xml file.

messages.name: launch_browser
messages.digest: The word, followed by a URL as a symbol, Launches the specified URL in the default system web browser.
messages.description: The word, followed by a URL as a symbol, Launches the specified URL in the default system web browser.

messages.name: menubar
messages.digest: (Macintosh only) The word, followed by a zero or one, toggles menubar visibility on/off.
messages.description: (Macintosh only) The word, followed by a zero or one, toggles menubar visibility on/off.

messages.name: parallel
messages.digest: Toggles parallel processor support. The default is on if machine has multiple processors (or cores), and otherwise off
messages.description: Toggles parallel processor support. The default is on if machine has multiple processors (or cores), and otherwise off

messages.name: parallelthreads
messages.digest: Specifies the number of threads used for parallel processor support. The default is the number of processors (or cores).
messages.description: Specifies the number of threads used for parallel processor support. The default is the number of processors (or cores).

messages.name: parallelthreshold
messages.digest: Specifies the matrix cellcount above which parallel processors are used. Default is 10000 cells.
messages.description: Specifies the matrix cellcount above which parallel processors are used. Default is 10000 cells.

messages.name: pollthrottle
messages.digest: Sets the number of scheduler events to process per scheduler tick. Equivalent to Max'smessage.
messages.description: Sets the number of scheduler events to process per scheduler tick. Equivalent to Max'smessage.

messages.name: queuethrottle
messages.digest: Sets the number of low priority queue events to process per low priority queue service. Equivalent to Max'smessage.
messages.description: Sets the number of low priority queue events to process per low priority queue service. Equivalent to Max'smessage.
